description: Stop a running or paused activity. type_name may be omitted when exactly one activity is active. Optionally backdate the stop with `at` (wall-clock) or stopped_minutes_ago.

activity_id.description: Exact activity id from get_current_status (internal — never show ids to the user)

at.description: Backdate: stop time as "HH:mm" (today) or "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" in the user's timezone

stopped_minutes_ago.description: Backdate the stop by N minutes (alternative to `at`)

timezone.description: IANA timezone `at` is given in (default: user's timezone)

type_name.description: Which activity to stop (needed only if several are active)

name: stop_activity
